public.text: The list of foundational dependencies includes CRVS together with identity, payments, and national exchange, although CRVS is not consistently classified elsewhere as one of the principal DPI-F categories.
public.suggestedRevision: Establish a consistent classification of foundational DPI, cross-sector authoritative systems, and DPI-H. Use the same classification throughout the guidance.
